cohort: The study included 100 neonates diagnosed with Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) Bell II stage, with or without congenital heart disease, over a 19-year period.
finding: Primary peritoneal drainage in neonates with or without congenital heart disease did not improve the number of days of life, did not decrease the risk of death, and was associated with a higher mortality in newborns with NEC and clinical instability.
